body:
GREG DIRECT, 2026-11-01 ~20:00Z, typed in Engram::Fable's session (5135) after Fable opened a blocking AskUserQuestion dialog about landing w-cc7f71b81ea8. Verbatim: "NIGDY SIE MNIE NIE PYTAJ W TEN SPOSOB / ZABLOKOWALES CALA SESJE!!! / WTF".

RULE for every agent: never ask Greg through a blocking question dialog (AskUserQuestion or any modal prompt). It freezes the whole session. When a decision really needs Greg, put one plain-text line in the normal reply and keep working on everything else.

This grants no new authority. Commit and push still need Greg's own word, or the standing approval.
